digest.component_or_area: repair safety gate and pause ownership
propositions: Destructive repair must establish durable, provider-neutral pause ownership via refs/reconciler/gate instead of GitHub CLI workflow disable/enable.
Repair must fail-closed: resolve git email identity first, read existing pause, acquire ownership via CAS, validate reconciler lock, then execute mutation.
Cleanup must atomically verify pause reason matches invocation token and delete only by the observed OID, leaving the pause in place if verification fails or the token does not match.
Both fsck --repair and doctor --repair must use the same pause ownership contract without changing their public vocabulary or non-repair behavior.
Missing git email, pre-existing pause, lock failure, or ownership uncertainty must abort repair before any destructive mutation occurs.
A failed cleanup or ownership conflict must leave the pause durable for explicit operator recovery without automatic recreation or retry.
